subject: general
question: Through which of the following states do the Western Ghats pass?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Western Ghats** is a mountain range that runs parallel to the western coast of the Indian peninsula, covering a total of six states in India: **Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Karnataka, Kerala, and Tamil Nadu**.
 
• **Tamil Nadu** is one of the key states where the **Western Ghats** extend. The range in Tamil Nadu is known for its rich biodiversity and is home to various hill stations like **Ooty (Nilgiris)**, **Kodaikanal**, and **Coimbatore hills**.
 
• The **Western Ghats** in Tamil Nadu include the **Nilgiri Hills, Anamalai Hills**, and **Cardamom Hills**, which are significant for their ecological and economic importance.
 
• The range has been designated as a **UNESCO World Heritage Site** due to its exceptional biodiversity and is considered one of the **eight hottest hotspots of biological diversity** in the world.
 
• The states mentioned in the other options, such as **Punjab, Bihar, and Uttar Pradesh**, are located in the northern and eastern parts of India and are not traversed by the **Western Ghats**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Geographical Coverage of the Western Ghats:**

 
 
• The **Western Ghats** stretch across six states: Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Karnataka, Kerala, and Tamil Nadu, covering a total length of approximately **1,600 km**.
 
• It forms the **watershed** for the **Peninsular Rivers**, including the Godavari, Krishna, and Kaveri, which are crucial for irrigation and drinking water.
 
 
 
• **Ecological Significance:**
 
 
• The Western Ghats is home to a large number of **endemic species** of flora and fauna, including the **Nilgiri Tahr** and the **Lion-tailed Macaque**.
 
• The range plays a critical role in influencing the **monsoon weather patterns** in the region and acts as a barrier to the southwest monsoon winds.
 
 
 
• **UNESCO World Heritage Site:**
 
 
• The Western Ghats was inscribed as a **UNESCO World Heritage Site** in **2012** for its exceptional natural beauty and unique ecosystem.
 
• It is recognized as one of the **eight hottest hotspots of biological diversity** in the world.
 
 
 
• **Hill Stations and Tourism:**
 
 
• The Western Ghats in Tamil Nadu is a significant tourist attraction due to the presence of popular hill stations such as **Ooty, Kodaikanal**, and **Valparai**.
 
• These hill stations are known for their **pleasant climate, tea plantations, and scenic beauty**.
 
 
 
• **Other States in the Question:**
 
 
• **Punjab:** Located in northern India, dominated by plains and does not feature the Western Ghats.
 
• **Bihar:** Situated in the eastern part of India, characterized by the Gangetic plains, and not traversed by the Western Ghats.
 
• **Uttar Pradesh:** A northern state predominantly covered by the Indo-Gangetic plains and not connected to the Western Ghats.
